info.name: Transcosmos Task Manager API
info.description:
Full API collection for the Transcosmos Task Manager (Laravel 12 + Sanctum).

Usage:
1. Import this file and the accompanying `task-manager.postman_environment.json`.
2. Run the **Auth / Login** request first — the test script auto-saves the token to `{{token}}`.
3. All other requests use `{{base_url}}` and `{{token}}` from the environment.

Default credentials: admin@contoh.com / password

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints — login, logout, and current user info.

request.description:
Authenticate with email and password. On success, the test script automatically saves `token` and `user_id` to the environment.

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "user": { "id": 1, "name": "Admin", "email": "admin@contoh.com", "role": "admin" },
  "token": "1|abc123..."
}
```

Returns the currently authenticated user's profile.

**Response 200:**
```json
{ "id": 1, "name": "Admin", "email": "admin@contoh.com", "role": "admin" }
```

Invalidates the current Bearer token. The test script clears `token` from the environment.

**Response 200:**
```json
{ "message": "Logged out successfully" }
```

item.name: Tasks
item.description: Task CRUD — list, create, show, update, delete. All require authentication.

query.description: Filter by status: todo | in_progress | done
Filter by priority: low | medium | high

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Fix login bug on mobile",
  "description": "The login button is unresponsive on iOS Safari. Investigate and fix.",
  "status": "todo",
  "priority": "high",
  "assigned_user_id": 2,
  "due_date": "2026-09-01"
}

request.description:
Creates a new task. `created_by` is automatically set to the authenticated user.

On success, the test script saves `task_id` to the environment for use in subsequent requests.

**Required fields:** `title`
**Optional fields:** `description`, `status` (default: `todo`), `priority` (default: `medium`), `assigned_user_id`, `due_date` (must be today or future)

**Response 201:** Full task object with `assignedUser` and `creator` relations.

Returns a single task with all relations loaded: `assignedUser`, `creator`, `attachments`, and `comments` (with commenter info).

**Response 200:** Task object with full relations.

Updates an existing task. Only the **task creator** or an **admin** can update.

All fields are optional (PATCH-like behavior). Only send fields you want to change.

**Response 403:** If authenticated user is neither the creator nor an admin.

Deletes a task. Only the **task creator** or an **admin** can delete.

**Response 200:**
```json
{ "message": "Task deleted successfully" }
```
**Response 403:** If not authorized.

item.name: Attachments
item.description: File attachment endpoints — upload, download, and delete. Files are stored in `storage/app/public/attachments/{task_id}/`. Images get a 300×300 thumbnail via PHP GD.

formdata.description: File to upload. Allowed types: jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, txt, csv, zip. Max 10 MB.

request.description:
Upload a file to a specific task. Send as `multipart/form-data` with key `file`.

**Allowed MIME types:** image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp, application/pdf, .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, text/plain, text/csv, application/zip
**Max size:** 10 MB

If the file is an image, a 300×300 cover-crop thumbnail is automatically generated.

On success, the test script saves `attachment_id` to the environment.

**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "task_id": 5,
  "file_name": "screenshot.png",
  "file_size": 204800,
  "mime_type": "image/png",
  "url": "http://localhost:8000/storage/attachments/5/uuid.png",
  "thumbnail_url": "http://localhost:8000/storage/attachments/5/thumb_uuid.jpg",
  "uploaded_at": "2026-08-24T09:00:00.000000Z"
}
```

Downloads the file as a binary stream with the original filename as `Content-Disposition: attachment`.

In the frontend, this is triggered via `fetch()` + Blob URL because `Authorization` headers cannot be sent via a plain `<a href>` link.

**Response:** Binary file stream with original filename.

Deletes the attachment record and its physical file from disk. If a thumbnail exists, it is also deleted.

**Response 200:**
```json
{ "message": "Attachment deleted successfully" }
```

item.name: Export
item.description: CSV export endpoints — dispatch a background export job, list generated files, and download them. The `queue:work` process must be running for exports to be generated.

exec: // Export is async — wait a few seconds, then call List Exports
console.log('Export job dispatched. Run queue:work if not already running.');

request.description:
Dispatches a background job (`ExportTasksCsv`) to generate a filtered CSV file.

All body fields are **optional**. Omit them to export all tasks.

**Optional filters:**
- `status`: `todo` | `in_progress` | `done`
- `priority`: `low` | `medium` | `high`
- `assigned_to`: user ID (integer)

**Response 202 (Accepted):**
```json
{
  "message": "Export job dispatched. File will be available in storage/exports/ shortly.",
  "filters": { "status": "todo", "priority": "high" }
}
```

> The job runs asynchronously. The CSV file appears after the queue worker processes the job.

Lists all generated CSV files in `storage/exports/`, sorted by most recent first.

The test script saves the latest filename to `{{export_filename}}`.

**Response 200:**
```json
[
  {
    "filename": "tasks_2026-08-24_090000.csv",
    "size_bytes": 4096,
    "generated_at": "2026-08-24 09:00:00",
    "download_url": "http://localhost:8000/api/exports/tasks/tasks_2026-08-24_090000.csv"
  }
]
```

Downloads a specific CSV export file by filename. The filename comes from the **List Exports** response.

**Response:** Binary CSV stream (`Content-Type: text/csv`).

**Response 404:** If the file does not exist.
